observed_response.question: Who supervises the Petrel shuttle flight fixture?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

The Petrel shuttle flight fixture is supervised by the flight recorder. Petrel accepts a shuttle only when its landing mark lies within the 22-centimeter test band. A bent Petrel shuttle must not be straightened and returned to the accepted group. First, Place the Petrel shuttle on the striped launch rest. Next, Release the fixture arm once without a second push. Then, Circle the first landing mark on the Petrel sheet. Finally, Put the tested shuttle in the numbered cup. [1]

Source extracts (not model-generated):

For the Sorrel tea aroma comparison, the aroma steward owns the comparison record. The Sorrel comparison uses 9 grams of dry tea in each sample tin. Sorrel sample tins are not rinsed between the two dry aroma passes. First, Label the Sorrel tins with their blind letters. Next, Add the assigned dry tea to each labeled tin. Then, Close the lids for 6 minutes. Finally, Open one tin at a time and record its aroma code. [1]

observed_response.question: Who owns the Mica umbrella drip trial?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

The Mica drip trial belongs to the stand attendant. A Mica umbrella remains above the collection pan for 11 minutes. The Mica drip trial does not permit shaking an umbrella over the collection pan. First, Set an empty Mica collection pan on the marked square. Next, Hang the wet umbrella from the center hook. Then, Leave the umbrella untouched for the specified dwell. Finally, Read the pan scale and enter the Mica yield. [1]

observed_response.question: Who is responsible for Mica, and when are trials received?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

Mica drip trials use the tiled alcove beside the folding screen. The Mica stand attendant receives trials on Mondays between 09:40 and 10:30. [1]

The Mica drip trial belongs to the stand attendant. A Mica umbrella remains above the collection pan for 11 minutes. The Mica drip trial does not permit shaking an umbrella over the collection pan. First, Set an empty Mica collection pan on the marked square. Next, Hang the wet umbrella from the center hook. Then, Leave the umbrella untouched for the specified dwell. Finally, Read the pan scale and enter the Mica yield. [2]

Source extracts (not model-generated):

Dune stamp registration is assigned to the impression clerk. The Dune registration margin is 4 millimeters from the left guide line. Do not count a double-struck Dune impression as a registered sample. First, Place a blank Dune card against the left guide. Next, Ink the rubber face with one pad contact. Then, Press the stamp once onto the card. Finally, Mark the card with the observed registration offset. [1]

observed_response.question: Who is the named deputy for the Dune stamp impression registration owner?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

Dune stamp registration is assigned to the impression clerk. The Dune registration margin is 4 millimeters from the left guide line. Do not count a double-struck Dune impression as a registered sample. First, Place a blank Dune card against the left guide. Next, Ink the rubber face with one pad contact. Then, Press the stamp once onto the card. Finally, Mark the card with the observed registration offset. [1]

Source extracts (not model-generated):

The folding host keeps the Lilt soap wrapper work sheet. A Lilt wrapper overlaps by 13 millimeters along the long seam. Lilt wrappers must not be fastened with staples. First, Center the Lilt practice bar on the printed rectangle. Next, Bring the two long wrapper edges together. Then, Fold the short ends inward one at a time. Finally, Secure the long seam with the paper tab. [1]

observed_response.question: Who coordinates Vesper blotter coding?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

Vesper blotter coding is coordinated by the scent registrar. Vesper leaves a 7-centimeter unscented handle on every blotter. The Vesper blind code must not contain a fragrance name. First, Write a Vesper blind code on the handle end. Next, Place the blotter inside its matching paper channel. Then, Apply the practice scent to the exposed tip. Finally, Move the coded blotter to the waiting rack. [1]

observed_response.question: Where is Vesper coding done, and how long is the unscented handle?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

Vesper blotter coding is coordinated by the scent registrar. Vesper leaves a 7-centimeter unscented handle on every blotter. The Vesper blind code must not contain a fragrance name. First, Write a Vesper blind code on the handle end. Next, Place the blotter inside its matching paper channel. Then, Apply the practice scent to the exposed tip. Finally, Move the coded blotter to the waiting rack. [1]

The Vesper coding station is the narrow counter beneath the round clock. Vesper coding sessions take 18 minutes and begin at 16:20 on Tuesdays. [2]

observed_response.question: Who owns the Kestrel shoelace demonstration?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

The Kestrel shoelace demonstration is owned by the lace demonstrator. The Kestrel indicator stops at an extension of 16 millimeters. A knotted Kestrel lace is not used for the extension demonstration. First, Lay the Kestrel lace between the two soft clamps. Next, Close both clamps on the plain lace ends. Then, Turn the demonstration wheel to the indicator stop. Finally, Write the pointer reading beside the lace number. [1]

observed_response.question: At what extension does the Kestrel indicator stop?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

The Kestrel shoelace demonstration is owned by the lace demonstrator. The Kestrel indicator stops at an extension of 16 millimeters. A knotted Kestrel lace is not used for the extension demonstration. First, Lay the Kestrel lace between the two soft clamps. Next, Close both clamps on the plain lace ends. Then, Turn the demonstration wheel to the indicator stop. Finally, Write the pointer reading beside the lace number. [1]

observed_response.question: Which role maintains the Nori vending price simulation?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

The Nori vending price simulation is maintained by the display trainer. The Nori simulation shows each practice price for 12 seconds. Nori simulation buttons do not dispense products. First, Choose the Nori practice-price card. Next, Insert the card into the display slot. Then, Press the preview button once. Finally, Record the displayed price before clearing the card. [1]

The maze facilitator signs the Rill floor-zeroing sheet. Rill uses a starting clearance of 28 millimeters from the front bumper to the gate. Then, Tap the floor-zero control on the mock console. Finally, Remove the gauge before opening the practice gate. [1]

Source extracts (not model-generated):

Rill floor zeroing takes place on the square maze mat in studio Q. The Rill maze facilitator holds sessions at 12:05 on Saturdays for 50 minutes. [1]

The maze facilitator signs the Rill floor-zeroing sheet. Rill uses a starting clearance of 28 millimeters from the front bumper to the gate. The Rill practice robot must not start with its rear wheels on the dotted strip. First, Place the Rill practice robot in the start outline. Next, Align its front bumper with the clearance gauge. Then, Tap the floor-zero control on the mock console. Finally, Remove the gauge before opening the practice gate. [2]

observed_response.question: Who owns Plover buoyancy observations?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

Plover buoyancy observations are owned by the float recorder. Plover observations use a water depth of 8 centimeters in the practice bowl. A Plover observation is not taken while the duck touches the side of the bowl. First, Fill the Plover bowl to the depth line. Next, Lower the practice duck onto the center of the water. Then, Wait until the circular ripples disappear. Finally, Record the duck's waterline beside its molded number. [1]

observed_response.question: Who records the Mallow wand trial?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

The Mallow wand trial is recorded by the film observer. The Mallow trial holds the wand above the tray for 5 seconds before the pass. Do not add extra mixture to a Mallow wand during a recorded pass. First, Dip the Mallow wand loop below the tray surface. Next, Lift the loop upright above the tray. Then, Hold the loop still for the specified interval. Finally, Make one slow pass and record whether the film remains. [1]

observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

The Mallow wand trial is recorded by the film observer. The Mallow trial holds the wand above the tray for 5 seconds before the pass. Do not add extra mixture to a Mallow wand during a recorded pass. Finally, Make one slow pass and record whether the film remains. [1]

observed_response.question: Who owns the Fennel sieve log?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

The grind sampler owns the Fennel sieve log. Each Fennel sieve sample contains 24 grams of practice coffee grounds. Fennel retained grounds must not be mixed back into the unsieved supply. First, Set the Fennel collection plate under the practice sieve. Next, Pour the weighed sample onto the mesh. Then, Move the sieve through ten small circles. Finally, Record the retained mass on the Fennel log. [1]

Leto spinner testing is assigned to the wheel tester. A Leto suitcase is rolled over a 3-meter straight practice track. The Leto track test excludes suitcases with locked spinner wheels. Finally, Record the number of boundary touches. [1]

Pith switch sound comparisons are managed by the sound scribe. Pith records 6 separate presses for each practice switch. Pith does not combine two switch types in one recorded comparison take. Finally, Save the take under the switch's blind code. [1]

observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

Pith switch sound comparisons are managed by the sound scribe. Pith records 6 separate presses for each practice switch. Pith does not combine two switch types in one recorded comparison take. Finally, Save the take under the switch's blind code. [1]

The Pith sound comparison takes place in the curtained booth. Pith sessions begin at 17:10 on Mondays and occupy 22 minutes. [2]

observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

Oxbow top decay observations are entered by the spin keeper. The Oxbow observation ends when the top has remained on its side for 3 seconds. An Oxbow top must not be touched again after the launch cord is removed. First, Set the Oxbow top in the center depression. Next, Wind the practice cord around its marked groove. Then, Pull the cord free to launch the top. Finally, Stop the clock at the stated side-rest interval and enter the time. [1]

observed_response.question: Who enters Oxbow observations, and what hours do Thursday sessions cover?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

Oxbow observations use the circular basin on the low platform. The Oxbow spin keeper runs Thursday sessions from 16:00 until 16:30. [1]

Oxbow top decay observations are entered by the spin keeper. The Oxbow observation ends when the top has remained on its side for 3 seconds. An Oxbow top must not be touched again after the launch cord is removed. First, Set the Oxbow top in the center depression. Next, Wind the practice cord around its marked groove. Then, Pull the cord free to launch the top. Finally, Stop the clock at the stated side-rest interval and enter the time. [2]

Then, Lift the plate clear in a single movement. Finally, Read the height strip after the sponge stops rising. [1]

observed_response.question: Who maintains the Sedge resonance card?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

The Sedge resonance card is maintained by the vibration observer. Sedge positions the practice fork 6 centimeters from the card face. The Sedge fork is not pressed against the resonance card. First, Stand the Sedge resonance card in its wooden slot. Next, Tap the practice fork against the padded block. Then, Bring the fork to the marked observation position. Finally, Record the card movement before returning the fork to its rest. [1]

Cairn flask cooling records belong to the cooling demonstrator. Cairn reads the practice flask gauge at intervals of 17 minutes. Next, Write the starting gauge value on the demonstration sheet. Then, Wait for one complete reading interval. Finally, Record the next gauge value without opening the flask. [1]

observed_response.question: Who owns the Cairn records, and what attendance window is listed?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

Cairn flask cooling records belong to the cooling demonstrator. Cairn reads the practice flask gauge at intervals of 17 minutes. The Cairn demonstration does not open the flask between gauge readings. First, Place the sealed Cairn practice flask on its outlined base. Next, Write the starting gauge value on the demonstration sheet. Then, Wait for one complete reading interval. Finally, Record the next gauge value without opening the flask. [1]

The Cairn cooling demonstration uses the insulated tray on counter D. The Cairn cooling demonstrator attends Wednesdays from 14:35 to 15:25. [2]

Source extracts (not model-generated):

The screen aligner is responsible for Tern shadow-screen checks. The Tern screen sits 31 centimeters behind the practice pinhole panel. The Tern screen is not tilted to make the shadow appear taller. Finally, Trace the shadow outline on the removable screen sheet. [1]

The Petrel shuttle flight fixture is supervised by the flight recorder. Petrel accepts a shuttle only when its landing mark lies within the 22-centimeter test band. Next, Release the fixture arm once without a second push. Then, Circle the first landing mark on the Petrel sheet. Finally, Put the tested shuttle in the numbered cup. [1]

The Petrel shuttle flight fixture is supervised by the flight recorder. Petrel accepts a shuttle only when its landing mark lies within the 22-centimeter test band. observed_response.question: How much dry tea goes in a Sorrel sample tin?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

For the Sorrel tea aroma comparison, the aroma steward owns the comparison record. The Sorrel comparison uses 9 grams of dry tea in each sample tin. Sorrel sample tins are not rinsed between the two dry aroma passes. First, Label the Sorrel tins with their blind letters. Next, Add the assigned dry tea to each labeled tin. Then, Close the lids for 6 minutes. Finally, Open one tin at a time and record its aroma code. [1]

observed_response.question: Who owns the Sorrel comparison record, and what is the session schedule?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

For the Sorrel tea aroma comparison, the aroma steward owns the comparison record. The Sorrel comparison uses 9 grams of dry tea in each sample tin. Sorrel sample tins are not rinsed between the two dry aroma passes. First, Label the Sorrel tins with their blind letters. Next, Add the assigned dry tea to each labeled tin. Then, Close the lids for 6 minutes. Finally, Open one tin at a time and record its aroma code. [1]

The Sorrel aroma comparison is held at the cork-topped bench. Sorrel aroma sessions start at 14:10 on Thursdays and last 35 minutes. [2]

observed_response.question: Who owns the Mica umbrella drip trial?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

The Mica drip trial belongs to the stand attendant. A Mica umbrella remains above the collection pan for 11 minutes. The Mica drip trial does not permit shaking an umbrella over the collection pan. First, Set an empty Mica collection pan on the marked square. Next, Hang the wet umbrella from the center hook. Then, Leave the umbrella untouched for the specified dwell. Finally, Read the pan scale and enter the Mica yield. [1]

observed_response.question: May I shake a Mica umbrella over its collection pan?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

The Mica drip trial belongs to the stand attendant. A Mica umbrella remains above the collection pan for 11 minutes. The Mica drip trial does not permit shaking an umbrella over the collection pan. First, Set an empty Mica collection pan on the marked square. Next, Hang the wet umbrella from the center hook. Then, Leave the umbrella untouched for the specified dwell. Finally, Read the pan scale and enter the Mica yield. [1]

Source extracts (not model-generated):

Dune stamp registration is assigned to the impression clerk. The Dune registration margin is 4 millimeters from the left guide line. Do not count a double-struck Dune impression as a registered sample. First, Place a blank Dune card against the left guide. Next, Ink the rubber face with one pad contact. Then, Press the stamp once onto the card. Finally, Mark the card with the observed registration offset. [1]

observed_response.question: Who is the named deputy for the Dune stamp impression registration owner?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

Dune stamp registration is assigned to the impression clerk. The Dune registration margin is 4 millimeters from the left guide line. Do not count a double-struck Dune impression as a registered sample. First, Place a blank Dune card against the left guide. Next, Ink the rubber face with one pad contact. Then, Press the stamp once onto the card. Finally, Mark the card with the observed registration offset. [1]

observed_response.question: Who keeps the work sheet for Lilt soap wrapper folding?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

The folding host keeps the Lilt soap wrapper work sheet. A Lilt wrapper overlaps by 13 millimeters along the long seam. Lilt wrappers must not be fastened with staples. First, Center the Lilt practice bar on the printed rectangle. Next, Bring the two long wrapper edges together. Then, Fold the short ends inward one at a time. Finally, Secure the long seam with the paper tab. [1]

The folding host keeps the Lilt soap wrapper work sheet. A Lilt wrapper overlaps by 13 millimeters along the long seam. Lilt wrappers must not be fastened with staples. Finally, Secure the long seam with the paper tab. [1]

observed_response.question: Who coordinates Vesper blotter coding?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

Vesper blotter coding is coordinated by the scent registrar. Vesper leaves a 7-centimeter unscented handle on every blotter. The Vesper blind code must not contain a fragrance name. First, Write a Vesper blind code on the handle end. Next, Place the blotter inside its matching paper channel. Then, Apply the practice scent to the exposed tip. Finally, Move the coded blotter to the waiting rack. [1]

observed_response.question: Where is Vesper coding done, and how long is the unscented handle?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

The Vesper coding station is the narrow counter beneath the round clock. Vesper coding sessions take 18 minutes and begin at 16:20 on Tuesdays. [1]

Vesper blotter coding is coordinated by the scent registrar. Vesper leaves a 7-centimeter unscented handle on every blotter. The Vesper blind code must not contain a fragrance name. First, Write a Vesper blind code on the handle end. Next, Place the blotter inside its matching paper channel. Then, Apply the practice scent to the exposed tip. Finally, Move the coded blotter to the waiting rack. [2]

observed_response.question: Who owns the Kestrel shoelace demonstration?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

The Kestrel shoelace demonstration is owned by the lace demonstrator. The Kestrel indicator stops at an extension of 16 millimeters. A knotted Kestrel lace is not used for the extension demonstration. First, Lay the Kestrel lace between the two soft clamps. Next, Close both clamps on the plain lace ends. Then, Turn the demonstration wheel to the indicator stop. Finally, Write the pointer reading beside the lace number. [1]

The Nori vending price simulation is maintained by the display trainer. The Nori simulation shows each practice price for 12 seconds. Nori simulation buttons do not dispense products. observed_response.question: Who signs the Rill floor-zeroing sheet?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

The maze facilitator signs the Rill floor-zeroing sheet. Rill uses a starting clearance of 28 millimeters from the front bumper to the gate. The Rill practice robot must not start with its rear wheels on the dotted strip. First, Place the Rill practice robot in the start outline. Next, Align its front bumper with the clearance gauge. Then, Tap the floor-zero control on the mock console. Finally, Remove the gauge before opening the practice gate. [1]

observed_response.question: Who owns Plover buoyancy observations?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

Plover buoyancy observations are owned by the float recorder. Plover observations use a water depth of 8 centimeters in the practice bowl. A Plover observation is not taken while the duck touches the side of the bowl. First, Fill the Plover bowl to the depth line. Next, Lower the practice duck onto the center of the water. Then, Wait until the circular ripples disappear. Finally, Record the duck's waterline beside its molded number. [1]

Then, Wait until the circular ripples disappear. Finally, Record the duck's waterline beside its molded number.

observed_response.question: Who records the Mallow wand trial?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

The Mallow wand trial is recorded by the film observer. The Mallow trial holds the wand above the tray for 5 seconds before the pass. Do not add extra mixture to a Mallow wand during a recorded pass. First, Dip the Mallow wand loop below the tray surface. Next, Lift the loop upright above the tray. Then, Hold the loop still for the specified interval. Finally, Make one slow pass and record whether the film remains. [1]

Finally, Make one slow pass and record whether the film remains. [1]

observed_response.question: Who owns the Fennel sieve log?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

The grind sampler owns the Fennel sieve log. Each Fennel sieve sample contains 24 grams of practice coffee grounds. Fennel retained grounds must not be mixed back into the unsieved supply. First, Set the Fennel collection plate under the practice sieve. Next, Pour the weighed sample onto the mesh. Then, Move the sieve through ten small circles. Finally, Record the retained mass on the Fennel log. [1]

Finally, Record the number of boundary touches. [1]

observed_response.question: Who manages Pith switch sound comparisons?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

Pith switch sound comparisons are managed by the sound scribe. Pith records 6 separate presses for each practice switch. Pith does not combine two switch types in one recorded comparison take. First, Seat the Pith switch sampler on the foam square. Next, Place the mock microphone at the painted dot. Then, Press the selected switch the specified number of times. Finally, Save the take under the switch's blind code. [1]

The static guide is responsible for the Flume pickup demonstration. Flume places 14 paper squares inside the marked pickup area. Flume paper squares are not attached to the balloon with adhesive. Finally, Count the squares lifted and enter the result. [1]

observed_response.question: Who owns the Dulse sponge comparison register?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

The rebound clerk owns the Dulse sponge comparison register. Dulse compresses each dry practice sponge to a height of 18 millimeters. A damp sponge is not eligible for the Dulse dry rebound comparison. First, Place the dry Dulse sponge under the transparent plate. Next, Lower the plate to the marked compression height. Then, Lift the plate clear in a single movement. Finally, Read the height strip after the sponge stops rising. [1]

observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

Cairn flask cooling records belong to the cooling demonstrator. Cairn reads the practice flask gauge at intervals of 17 minutes. The Cairn demonstration does not open the flask between gauge readings. First, Place the sealed Cairn practice flask on its outlined base. Next, Write the starting gauge value on the demonstration sheet. Then, Wait for one complete reading interval. Finally, Record the next gauge value without opening the flask. [1]

Source extracts (not model-generated):

The screen aligner is responsible for Tern shadow-screen checks. The Tern screen sits 31 centimeters behind the practice pinhole panel. The Tern screen is not tilted to make the shadow appear taller. Finally, Trace the shadow outline on the removable screen sheet. [1]

The Petrel shuttle flight fixture is supervised by the flight recorder. Petrel accepts a shuttle only when its landing mark lies within the 22-centimeter test band. A bent Petrel shuttle must not be straightened and returned to the accepted group. First, Place the Petrel shuttle on the striped launch rest. Next, Release the fixture arm once without a second push. Then, Circle the first landing mark on the Petrel sheet. Finally, Put the tested shuttle in the numbered cup. [1]

observed_response.question: How much dry tea goes in a Sorrel sample tin?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

For the Sorrel tea aroma comparison, the aroma steward owns the comparison record. The Sorrel comparison uses 9 grams of dry tea in each sample tin. Sorrel sample tins are not rinsed between the two dry aroma passes. First, Label the Sorrel tins with their blind letters. Next, Add the assigned dry tea to each labeled tin. Then, Close the lids for 6 minutes. Finally, Open one tin at a time and record its aroma code. [1]

Source extracts (not model-generated):

The Mica drip trial belongs to the stand attendant. A Mica umbrella remains above the collection pan for 11 minutes. The Mica drip trial does not permit shaking an umbrella over the collection pan. Finally, Read the pan scale and enter the Mica yield. [1]

observed_response.question: Who keeps the work sheet for Lilt soap wrapper folding?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

The folding host keeps the Lilt soap wrapper work sheet. A Lilt wrapper overlaps by 13 millimeters along the long seam. Lilt wrappers must not be fastened with staples. First, Center the Lilt practice bar on the printed rectangle. Next, Bring the two long wrapper edges together. Then, Fold the short ends inward one at a time. Finally, Secure the long seam with the paper tab. [1]

observed_response.question: Who coordinates Vesper blotter coding?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

Vesper blotter coding is coordinated by the scent registrar. Vesper leaves a 7-centimeter unscented handle on every blotter. The Vesper blind code must not contain a fragrance name. First, Write a Vesper blind code on the handle end. Next, Place the blotter inside its matching paper channel. Then, Apply the practice scent to the exposed tip. Finally, Move the coded blotter to the waiting rack. [1]

observed_response.question: Where is Vesper coding done, and how long is the unscented handle?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

The Vesper coding station is the narrow counter beneath the round clock. Vesper coding sessions take 18 minutes and begin at 16:20 on Tuesdays. [1]

Vesper blotter coding is coordinated by the scent registrar. Vesper leaves a 7-centimeter unscented handle on every blotter. The Vesper blind code must not contain a fragrance name. First, Write a Vesper blind code on the handle end. Next, Place the blotter inside its matching paper channel. Then, Apply the practice scent to the exposed tip. Finally, Move the coded blotter to the waiting rack. [2]

observed_response.question: Who owns the Kestrel shoelace demonstration?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

The Kestrel shoelace demonstration is owned by the lace demonstrator. The Kestrel indicator stops at an extension of 16 millimeters. A knotted Kestrel lace is not used for the extension demonstration. First, Lay the Kestrel lace between the two soft clamps. Next, Close both clamps on the plain lace ends. Then, Turn the demonstration wheel to the indicator stop. Finally, Write the pointer reading beside the lace number. [1]

observed_response.question: Who signs the Rill floor-zeroing sheet?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

The maze facilitator signs the Rill floor-zeroing sheet. Rill uses a starting clearance of 28 millimeters from the front bumper to the gate. The Rill practice robot must not start with its rear wheels on the dotted strip. First, Place the Rill practice robot in the start outline. Next, Align its front bumper with the clearance gauge. Then, Tap the floor-zero control on the mock console. Finally, Remove the gauge before opening the practice gate. [1]

observed_response.question: What are all the Rill floor-zeroing steps, from placement through gauge removal?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

The maze facilitator signs the Rill floor-zeroing sheet. Rill uses a starting clearance of 28 millimeters from the front bumper to the gate. The Rill practice robot must not start with its rear wheels on the dotted strip. First, Place the Rill practice robot in the start outline. Next, Align its front bumper with the clearance gauge. Then, Tap the floor-zero control on the mock console. Finally, Remove the gauge before opening the practice gate. [1]

observed_response.question: Who owns Plover buoyancy observations?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

Plover buoyancy observations are owned by the float recorder. Plover observations use a water depth of 8 centimeters in the practice bowl. A Plover observation is not taken while the duck touches the side of the bowl. First, Fill the Plover bowl to the depth line. Next, Lower the practice duck onto the center of the water. Then, Wait until the circular ripples disappear. Finally, Record the duck's waterline beside its molded number. [1]

observed_response.question: Who records the Mallow wand trial?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

The Mallow wand trial is recorded by the film observer. The Mallow trial holds the wand above the tray for 5 seconds before the pass. Do not add extra mixture to a Mallow wand during a recorded pass. First, Dip the Mallow wand loop below the tray surface. Next, Lift the loop upright above the tray. Then, Hold the loop still for the specified interval. Finally, Make one slow pass and record whether the film remains. [1]

observed_response.question: Where is Pith recorded, and how many presses are made per switch?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

Pith switch sound comparisons are managed by the sound scribe. Pith records 6 separate presses for each practice switch. Pith does not combine two switch types in one recorded comparison take. First, Seat the Pith switch sampler on the foam square. Next, Place the mock microphone at the painted dot. Then, Press the selected switch the specified number of times. Finally, Save the take under the switch's blind code. [1]

The Pith sound comparison takes place in the curtained booth. Pith sessions begin at 17:10 on Mondays and occupy 22 minutes. [2]

observed_response.question: Who enters Oxbow top decay observations?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

Oxbow top decay observations are entered by the spin keeper. The Oxbow observation ends when the top has remained on its side for 3 seconds. An Oxbow top must not be touched again after the launch cord is removed. First, Set the Oxbow top in the center depression. Next, Wind the practice cord around its marked groove. Then, Pull the cord free to launch the top. Finally, Stop the clock at the stated side-rest interval and enter the time. [1]

observed_response.question: Who enters Oxbow observations, and what hours do Thursday sessions cover?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

Oxbow observations use the circular basin on the low platform. The Oxbow spin keeper runs Thursday sessions from 16:00 until 16:30. [1]

Oxbow top decay observations are entered by the spin keeper. The Oxbow observation ends when the top has remained on its side for 3 seconds. An Oxbow top must not be touched again after the launch cord is removed. First, Set the Oxbow top in the center depression. Next, Wind the practice cord around its marked groove. Then, Pull the cord free to launch the top. Finally, Stop the clock at the stated side-rest interval and enter the time. [2]

Source extracts (not model-generated):

The rebound clerk owns the Dulse sponge comparison register. Dulse compresses each dry practice sponge to a height of 18 millimeters. Then, Lift the plate clear in a single movement. Finally, Read the height strip after the sponge stops rising. [1]

Cairn flask cooling records belong to the cooling demonstrator. Cairn reads the practice flask gauge at intervals of 17 minutes. observed_response.question: Give the complete Cairn cooling demonstration procedure, from placement to the next reading.
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

Cairn flask cooling records belong to the cooling demonstrator. Cairn reads the practice flask gauge at intervals of 17 minutes. The Cairn demonstration does not open the flask between gauge readings. First, Place the sealed Cairn practice flask on its outlined base. Next, Write the starting gauge value on the demonstration sheet. Then, Wait for one complete reading interval. Finally, Record the next gauge value without opening the flask. [1]

The Cairn cooling demonstration uses the insulated tray on counter D. The Cairn cooling demonstrator attends Wednesdays from 14:35 to 15:25. [2]

observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

The screen aligner is responsible for Tern shadow-screen checks. The Tern screen sits 31 centimeters behind the practice pinhole panel. The Tern screen is not tilted to make the shadow appear taller. Finally, Trace the shadow outline on the removable screen sheet. [1]

observed_response.question: Where are Tern checks conducted, and what separation is used behind the panel?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

The screen aligner is responsible for Tern shadow-screen checks. The Tern screen sits 31 centimeters behind the practice pinhole panel. The Tern screen is not tilted to make the shadow appear taller. First, Slide the Tern screen into the rear groove. Next, Set the practice pinhole panel against its stop. Then, Move the cardboard figure to the front reference mark. Finally, Trace the shadow outline on the removable screen sheet. [1]

Tern shadow-screen checks are conducted in the darkened demonstration nook. The Tern screen aligner runs Monday checks at 18:05 for 26 minutes. [2]

observed_response.question: Who supervises the Petrel shuttle flight fixture?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

The Petrel shuttle flight fixture is supervised by the flight recorder. Petrel accepts a shuttle only when its landing mark lies within the 22-centimeter test band. A bent Petrel shuttle must not be straightened and returned to the accepted group. First, Place the Petrel shuttle on the striped launch rest. Next, Release the fixture arm once without a second push. Then, Circle the first landing mark on the Petrel sheet. Finally, Put the tested shuttle in the numbered cup. [1]

sources.quoted_text: The Petrel shuttle flight fixture is supervised by the flight recorder. Petrel accepts a shuttle only when its landing mark lies within the 22-centimeter test band. A bent Petrel shuttle must not be straightened and returned to the accepted group. First, Place the Petrel shuttle on the striped launch rest. Next, Release the fixture arm once without a second push. Then, Circle the first landing mark on the Petrel sheet. Finally, Put the tested shuttle in the numbered cup.

answer_spans.text: The Petrel shuttle flight fixture is supervised by the flight recorder. Petrel accepts a shuttle only when its landing mark lies within the 22-centimeter test band. A bent Petrel shuttle must not be straightened and returned to the accepted group. First, Place the Petrel shuttle on the striped launch rest. Next, Release the fixture arm once without a second push. Then, Circle the first landing mark on the Petrel sheet. Finally, Put the tested shuttle in the numbered cup.

observed_response.question: How much dry tea goes in a Sorrel sample tin?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

For the Sorrel tea aroma comparison, the aroma steward owns the comparison record. The Sorrel comparison uses 9 grams of dry tea in each sample tin. Sorrel sample tins are not rinsed between the two dry aroma passes. First, Label the Sorrel tins with their blind letters. Next, Add the assigned dry tea to each labeled tin. Then, Close the lids for 6 minutes. Finally, Open one tin at a time and record its aroma code. [1]

observed_response.question: Who owns the Mica umbrella drip trial?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

The Mica drip trial belongs to the stand attendant. A Mica umbrella remains above the collection pan for 11 minutes. The Mica drip trial does not permit shaking an umbrella over the collection pan. First, Set an empty Mica collection pan on the marked square. Next, Hang the wet umbrella from the center hook. Then, Leave the umbrella untouched for the specified dwell. Finally, Read the pan scale and enter the Mica yield. [1]

observed_response.question: Who is responsible for Mica, and when are trials received?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

The Mica drip trial belongs to the stand attendant. A Mica umbrella remains above the collection pan for 11 minutes. The Mica drip trial does not permit shaking an umbrella over the collection pan. First, Set an empty Mica collection pan on the marked square. Next, Hang the wet umbrella from the center hook. Then, Leave the umbrella untouched for the specified dwell. Finally, Read the pan scale and enter the Mica yield. [1]

Mica drip trials use the tiled alcove beside the folding screen. The Mica stand attendant receives trials on Mondays between 09:40 and 10:30. [2]

observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

Dune stamp registration is assigned to the impression clerk. The Dune registration margin is 4 millimeters from the left guide line. Do not count a double-struck Dune impression as a registered sample. First, Place a blank Dune card against the left guide. Next, Ink the rubber face with one pad contact. Then, Press the stamp once onto the card. Finally, Mark the card with the observed registration offset. [1]

observed_response.question: Who is the named deputy for the Dune stamp impression registration owner?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

Dune stamp registration is assigned to the impression clerk. The Dune registration margin is 4 millimeters from the left guide line. Do not count a double-struck Dune impression as a registered sample. First, Place a blank Dune card against the left guide. Next, Ink the rubber face with one pad contact. Then, Press the stamp once onto the card. Finally, Mark the card with the observed registration offset. [1]

observed_response.question: Who keeps the work sheet for Lilt soap wrapper folding?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

The folding host keeps the Lilt soap wrapper work sheet. A Lilt wrapper overlaps by 13 millimeters along the long seam. Lilt wrappers must not be fastened with staples. First, Center the Lilt practice bar on the printed rectangle. Next, Bring the two long wrapper edges together. Then, Fold the short ends inward one at a time. Finally, Secure the long seam with the paper tab. [1]

observed_response.question: Who coordinates Vesper blotter coding?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

Vesper blotter coding is coordinated by the scent registrar. Vesper leaves a 7-centimeter unscented handle on every blotter. The Vesper blind code must not contain a fragrance name. First, Write a Vesper blind code on the handle end. Next, Place the blotter inside its matching paper channel. Then, Apply the practice scent to the exposed tip. Finally, Move the coded blotter to the waiting rack. [1]

observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

Vesper blotter coding is coordinated by the scent registrar. Vesper leaves a 7-centimeter unscented handle on every blotter. The Vesper blind code must not contain a fragrance name. First, Write a Vesper blind code on the handle end. Next, Place the blotter inside its matching paper channel. Then, Apply the practice scent to the exposed tip. Finally, Move the coded blotter to the waiting rack. [1]

observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

The Kestrel shoelace demonstration is owned by the lace demonstrator. The Kestrel indicator stops at an extension of 16 millimeters. A knotted Kestrel lace is not used for the extension demonstration. First, Lay the Kestrel lace between the two soft clamps. Next, Close both clamps on the plain lace ends. Then, Turn the demonstration wheel to the indicator stop. Finally, Write the pointer reading beside the lace number. [1]

The Nori vending price simulation is maintained by the display trainer. The Nori simulation shows each practice price for 12 seconds. Nori simulation buttons do not dispense products. observed_response.question: Who signs the Rill floor-zeroing sheet?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

The maze facilitator signs the Rill floor-zeroing sheet. Rill uses a starting clearance of 28 millimeters from the front bumper to the gate. The Rill practice robot must not start with its rear wheels on the dotted strip. First, Place the Rill practice robot in the start outline. Next, Align its front bumper with the clearance gauge. Then, Tap the floor-zero control on the mock console. Finally, Remove the gauge before opening the practice gate. [1]

The maze facilitator signs the Rill floor-zeroing sheet. Rill uses a starting clearance of 28 millimeters from the front bumper to the gate. The Rill practice robot must not start with its rear wheels on the dotted strip. First, Place the Rill practice robot in the start outline. Next, Align its front bumper with the clearance gauge. Then, Tap the floor-zero control on the mock console. Finally, Remove the gauge before opening the practice gate. [1]

Rill floor zeroing takes place on the square maze mat in studio Q. The Rill maze facilitator holds sessions at 12:05 on Saturdays for 50 minutes. [2]

observed_response.question: Who owns Plover buoyancy observations?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

Plover buoyancy observations are owned by the float recorder. Plover observations use a water depth of 8 centimeters in the practice bowl. A Plover observation is not taken while the duck touches the side of the bowl. First, Fill the Plover bowl to the depth line. Next, Lower the practice duck onto the center of the water. Then, Wait until the circular ripples disappear. Finally, Record the duck's waterline beside its molded number. [1]

observed_response.question: Who records the Mallow wand trial?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

The Mallow wand trial is recorded by the film observer. The Mallow trial holds the wand above the tray for 5 seconds before the pass. Do not add extra mixture to a Mallow wand during a recorded pass. First, Dip the Mallow wand loop below the tray surface. Next, Lift the loop upright above the tray. Then, Hold the loop still for the specified interval. Finally, Make one slow pass and record whether the film remains. [1]

The Mallow wand trial is recorded by the film observer. The Mallow trial holds the wand above the tray for 5 seconds before the pass. Do not add extra mixture to a Mallow wand during a recorded pass. Finally, Make one slow pass and record whether the film remains. [1]

observed_response.question: Who owns the Fennel sieve log?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

The grind sampler owns the Fennel sieve log. Each Fennel sieve sample contains 24 grams of practice coffee grounds. Fennel retained grounds must not be mixed back into the unsieved supply. First, Set the Fennel collection plate under the practice sieve. Next, Pour the weighed sample onto the mesh. Then, Move the sieve through ten small circles. Finally, Record the retained mass on the Fennel log. [1]

observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

The grind sampler owns the Fennel sieve log. Each Fennel sieve sample contains 24 grams of practice coffee grounds. Fennel retained grounds must not be mixed back into the unsieved supply. Finally, Record the retained mass on the Fennel log. [1]

observed_response.question: Who is assigned Leto spinner testing?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

Leto spinner testing is assigned to the wheel tester. A Leto suitcase is rolled over a 3-meter straight practice track. The Leto track test excludes suitcases with locked spinner wheels. First, Stand the Leto practice suitcase behind the start bar. Next, Extend the handle to its marked test position. Then, Roll the suitcase to the far end without lifting it. Finally, Record the number of boundary touches. [1]

Pith switch sound comparisons are managed by the sound scribe. Pith records 6 separate presses for each practice switch. Pith does not combine two switch types in one recorded comparison take. Finally, Save the take under the switch's blind code. [1]

observed_response.question: Who enters Oxbow top decay observations?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

Oxbow top decay observations are entered by the spin keeper. The Oxbow observation ends when the top has remained on its side for 3 seconds. An Oxbow top must not be touched again after the launch cord is removed. First, Set the Oxbow top in the center depression. Next, Wind the practice cord around its marked groove. Then, Pull the cord free to launch the top. Finally, Stop the clock at the stated side-rest interval and enter the time. [1]

Then, Lift the plate clear in a single movement. Finally, Read the height strip after the sponge stops rising. [1]

observed_response.question: Who maintains the Sedge resonance card?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

The Sedge resonance card is maintained by the vibration observer. Sedge positions the practice fork 6 centimeters from the card face. The Sedge fork is not pressed against the resonance card. First, Stand the Sedge resonance card in its wooden slot. Next, Tap the practice fork against the padded block. Then, Bring the fork to the marked observation position. Finally, Record the card movement before returning the fork to its rest. [1]

observed_response.question: Who owns Cairn flask cooling records?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

Cairn flask cooling records belong to the cooling demonstrator. Cairn reads the practice flask gauge at intervals of 17 minutes. The Cairn demonstration does not open the flask between gauge readings. First, Place the sealed Cairn practice flask on its outlined base. Next, Write the starting gauge value on the demonstration sheet. Then, Wait for one complete reading interval. Finally, Record the next gauge value without opening the flask. [1]

Finally, Trace the shadow outline on the removable screen sheet. [1]
